clauses.title: Period of Insurance
clauses.text: Cover operates only for loss or damage occurring between 00:00 hours on the policy start date and midnight on the policy end date shown in the Schedule. Loss occurring outside the period of insurance is not covered.

clauses.title: Premium Payment Condition
clauses.text: No liability attaches under this policy unless the premium has been paid in full and realised. If the premium cheque or mandate is dishonoured, the policy is void from inception.

clauses.title: Insured Vehicle
clauses.text: Cover applies only to the vehicle whose registration number, engine number and chassis number are stated in the Schedule. Loss to any other vehicle is not covered under Section I.

clauses.title: Section I — Own Damage: Accidental External Means
clauses.text: The Company will indemnify the insured against loss or damage to the insured vehicle and its accessories caused by accidental external means, including collision, overturning, and impact with any object.

clauses.title: Section I — Fire, Explosion, Self-Ignition and Lightning
clauses.text: Loss or damage caused by fire, explosion, self-ignition or lightning is covered.

clauses.title: Section I — Burglary, Housebreaking and Theft
clauses.text: Loss or damage by burglary, housebreaking or theft is covered, subject to the theft conditions in M-6.3. A First Information Report (FIR) must be lodged with the police and a copy provided to the Company.

clauses.title: Section I — Natural Calamities
clauses.text: Loss or damage caused by flood, inundation, storm, cyclone, hurricane, hailstorm, earthquake or landslide is covered. Claims under this clause are verified against meteorological records for the location and date of loss.

clauses.title: Section I — Malicious Act, Riot and Strike
clauses.text: Loss or damage caused by riot, strike, malicious act or terrorist activity is covered.

clauses.title: Section I — Glass Breakage
clauses.text: Damage to the windshield and windows is covered. Glass is not subject to depreciation. A windshield-only claim does not affect the No Claim Bonus where the add-on is opted.

clauses.title: Compulsory Deductible
clauses.text: Each and every claim under Section I is subject to a compulsory deductible of INR 1,000 for vehicles up to 1500cc and INR 2,000 above 1500cc, in addition to any voluntary deductible stated in the Schedule.

clauses.title: Depreciation on Parts Replaced
clauses.text: In the case of partial loss, depreciation is deducted from the cost of parts replaced: 50% on rubber, nylon, plastic parts, tyres, tubes and batteries; 30% on fibreglass components; nil on glass. Metal parts depreciate by vehicle age: not exceeding 6 months nil; 6 months to 1 year 5%; 1 to 2 years 10%; 2 to 3 years 15%; 3 to 4 years 25%; 4 to 5 years 35%; 5 to 10 years 40%; over 10 years 50%.

clauses.title: Insured Declared Value (IDV)
clauses.text: The maximum liability of the Company under Section I for any one claim shall not exceed the Insured Declared Value of the vehicle stated in the Schedule.

clauses.title: Total Loss and Constructive Total Loss
clauses.text: Where the cost of repair exceeds 75% of the IDV, the vehicle is treated as a Constructive Total Loss and the claim is settled on a total-loss basis at IDV less salvage, subject to the deductible.

clauses.title: Exclusion — Wear, Tear and Mechanical Breakdown
clauses.text: The Company is not liable for consequential loss, depreciation, wear and tear, or mechanical or electrical breakdown, failure or breakage.

clauses.title: Exclusion — Driving Under the Influence
clauses.text: The Company is not liable for any accidental loss or damage suffered whilst the insured or any person driving with the knowledge and consent of the insured is under the influence of intoxicating liquor or drugs.

clauses.title: Exclusion — Driver Without a Valid Licence
clauses.text: The Company is not liable for loss or damage occurring while the vehicle is driven by any person who does not hold an effective and valid driving licence.

clauses.title: Exclusion — Use for Hire or Reward
clauses.text: Cover does not apply where the private car is used for hire or reward, carriage of goods, organised racing or speed testing, contrary to the Limitations as to Use.

clauses.title: Exclusion — Consequential Engine Damage from Water
clauses.text: Damage to the engine caused by ingress of water (hydrostatic lock) resulting from the vehicle being driven or cranked in water-logged conditions is not covered, unless the Engine Protect add-on is opted.

clauses.title: Add-on — Zero Depreciation
clauses.text: Where Zero Depreciation is opted and shown in the Schedule, depreciation under M-3.2 is not deducted for up to two claims in the policy year.

clauses.title: Add-on — Engine Protect
clauses.text: Where Engine Protect is opted, the exclusion in M-4.5 does not apply and consequential engine damage due to water ingress is covered.

clauses.title: Condition — Notice of Loss
clauses.text: Notice shall be given to the Company immediately, and in any case within 48 hours, of any accidental loss or damage. Delayed notice may prejudice the Company's ability to investigate and may result in the claim being declined where the delay is unexplained.

clauses.title: Condition — Documents Required
clauses.text: The insured shall provide: a completed claim form, a copy of the Registration Certificate, a copy of the driving licence of the person driving at the time of loss, photographs of the damage, and a repair estimate from the repairer.

clauses.title: Condition — Theft
clauses.text: For theft claims the insured shall additionally provide the FIR, all original keys, and, where the vehicle is not traced within 90 days, the police non-traceable report.

clauses.title: Condition — Fraud
clauses.text: If any claim is in any respect fraudulent, or if any fraudulent means or devices are used by the insured or anyone acting on the insured's behalf to obtain any benefit, all benefits under this policy shall be forfeited.

clauses.title: Section II — Third Party Liability
clauses.text: Third-party bodily injury and property damage are covered under Section II. Third-party claims involving bodily injury or death are referred to the Motor Accident Claims Tribunal process and must be handled by a senior adjuster.

clauses.title: Period of Insurance and Premium
clauses.text: Cover applies to hospitalisation that begins during the policy period, provided the premium has been received in full. A policy in grace period does not cover hospitalisation that begins during the grace period.

clauses.title: Insured Persons
clauses.text: Only the members named in the Schedule are insured. The sum insured is shared on a floater basis among all insured members.

clauses.title: In-patient Hospitalisation
clauses.text: The Company will indemnify reasonable and customary medical expenses for in-patient hospitalisation of at least 24 consecutive hours, when advised by a registered medical practitioner, up to the sum insured.

clauses.title: Day Care Procedures
clauses.text: Listed day care procedures requiring less than 24 hours of hospitalisation due to technological advancement are covered.

clauses.title: Pre- and Post-Hospitalisation
clauses.text: Medical expenses incurred up to 30 days before and 60 days after hospitalisation are covered, provided the in-patient claim is admissible.

clauses.title: Room Rent Limit
clauses.text: Room rent, boarding and nursing are payable up to 1% of the sum insured per day for a normal room and 2% for ICU. If a higher category room is occupied, all associated medical expenses (except medicines, consumables and implants) are paid in the proportion that the eligible room rent bears to the actual room rent.

clauses.title: Co-payment
clauses.text: A co-payment of 10% applies to every admissible claim for an insured member aged 61 years or above at the time of admission.

clauses.title: Cataract Sub-limit
clauses.text: Cataract treatment is payable up to INR 40,000 per eye per policy year.

clauses.title: Initial Waiting Period
clauses.text: Expenses for any illness within the first 30 days from the first policy commencement date are excluded, except claims arising from an accident.

clauses.title: Pre-existing Diseases
clauses.text: Expenses related to the treatment of a pre-existing disease (PED) and its direct complications are excluded until the expiry of 36 months of continuous coverage after the date of inception of the first policy. A PED is any condition diagnosed, or for which medical advice or treatment was received, within 48 months before the first policy was issued.

clauses.title: Specified Disease Waiting Period
clauses.text: The following are excluded until the expiry of 24 months of continuous coverage: cataract, benign prostatic hypertrophy, hernia, hydrocele, joint replacement surgery, kidney stones, gallbladder stones, sinusitis, and varicose veins.

clauses.title: Exclusion — Cosmetic and Obesity Treatment
clauses.text: Cosmetic or plastic surgery, weight control and obesity treatment are excluded unless required as part of reconstruction following an accident or cancer.

clauses.title: Exclusion — Self-inflicted Injury and Substance Abuse
clauses.text: Intentional self-injury and treatment for alcohol or drug abuse, and any injury sustained under the influence of alcohol or drugs, are excluded.

clauses.title: Exclusion — Investigation and Evaluation
clauses.text: Admission primarily for diagnostic, X-ray or laboratory investigations not followed by active treatment is excluded.

clauses.title: Condition — Intimation
clauses.text: Planned hospitalisation must be intimated 48 hours before admission and emergency hospitalisation within 24 hours of admission.

clauses.title: Condition — Documents Required
clauses.text: Claims shall be supported by: the claim form, discharge summary, final hospital bill with itemised break-up, payment receipts, investigation reports, and prescriptions.

clauses.title: Condition — Network and Reimbursement
clauses.text: Cashless facility is available only at network hospitals. Claims at non-network hospitals are settled by reimbursement. The Company may decline treatment at hospitals placed on its exclusion list for prior irregularities.

clauses.title: Condition — Fraud
clauses.text: If any claim is fraudulent, or supported by a fraudulent document or declaration, all benefits under the policy are forfeited and premium paid is not refunded.
